verdict.rationale: Runway documents image-to-video generation as a core capability. Its generator produces 'video from text, an image or a clip', the API has an image-to-video endpoint (with draft previews), images can be supplied as base64 data URIs, and Gen-4.5's text-only mode is described as not requiring the usual input image. Kling 4.0 also generates video from frames and image references. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the subject and composition of the source image are preserved, and independent hands-on corroboration of image-to-video fidelity.
